summary: /deconstruyendo's cache layer says that an expired page is served at once and refreshed behind the visitor, that resized images are kept a year, and why these rules live in the Worker.

changes.before: Publicar una entrada purga, por etiqueta de caché, sus páginas y las que la listan. Menús y ajustes no se purgan: caducan antes de una hora.
changes.after: Publicar una entrada purga, por etiqueta de caché, sus páginas y las que la listan. Menús y ajustes no se purgan: se renuevan pasada una hora.

before.text: Las imágenes redimensionadas se guardan en la [`Cache API`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/cache/).

after.text: Las imágenes redimensionadas se guardan un año: su dirección ya dice de qué imagen salen y a qué tamaño, así que no cambian.

Una copia caducada se entrega al momento y se rehace por detrás, durante una semana. Solo se espera al Worker tras un despliegue, tras publicar esa página o tras una semana sin visitas. Estas reglas viven en el Worker, porque las de caché de la zona no alcanzan a `Workers Cache`.

changes.before: Publishing an entry purges, by cache tag, its own pages and the pages that list it. Menus and settings are not purged; they expire within the hour.
changes.after: Publishing an entry purges, by cache tag, its own pages and the pages that list it. Menus and settings are not purged; they are refreshed once the hour is up.

before.text: Resized images are kept in the [`Cache API`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/cache/).

after.text: Resized images are kept for a year: their address already says which image they come from and at what size, so they never change.

An expired copy is served at once and rebuilt behind the request, for up to a week. Nobody waits for the Worker except after a deploy, after that page is published, or after a week without visits. These rules live in the Worker, because the zone's cache rules do not reach `Workers Cache`.
